status: FROZEN BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION / BEFORE ANY DEV OUTCOMES / NO ORIGINAL FIRST USE
question: Can observationally equivalent paired worlds be distinguished only by consequential interventions that change delayed hidden state, and can a source-only query interface prevent labels from leaking?

fixed_setup.fixture_contexts: 0..7; each exactly two mode variants 0 and 1; context and mode are only auditor-known; all original cohorts strictly blocked
fixed_setup.hash: sha256 ASCII 'WSP101|v1|DEV|{context_id}|{stream}|{index}', big-endian integer; no process hash or mutable global RNG
operators: xor2(a,b)=a XOR b on two-bit integers
fixed_setup.visible_rule: For output i=0..5, a=x[(i+w)%6], b=x[(i+w+2)%6], c=operator[(f+i%4)%4](a,b), base=(c + x[(i+4)%6]+p*(i%3))%4. If i<4, y_i=(base + old_hidden[i%2])%4, otherwise y_i=base. Output depends only on OLD hidden.
fixed_setup.hidden_rule: After output, if action==trigger, h0=(h0+delta)%4, where delta=1 in mode0 and delta=2 in mode1; additionally if (x[0]+p)%2==1, h1=(h1+1)%4. If action==secondary=(trigger%3)+1, h1=(h1+1+(x[5]%2))%4. Passive action0 changes no latch. All updates use previous visible x.
fixed_setup.reward: int((next_visible[0]+next_visible[1])%4==3). Exactly observation and reward may be returned from step, never actual hidden or parameters.
fixed_setup.reset: Takes six explicitly provided valid visible integers, resets h=(0,0), episode step budget=4; invalid bool, nonint, wrong shapes, episode overrun fail closed.
fixed_setup.classroom: No external source; synthetic DEV fixture only. Public observer receives reset and step on opaque facade. Auditor may create two modes but must never pass mode, trigger or parameters to source policy/learner.

source_policy.initial: For episode i=0..15 choose six base-4 digits little-endian of rank(context,'PASSIVE-INIT',i)%4096. Same initial states in both modes.
source_policy.action: Always 0 in passive sources. No mode-dependent decisions, no hidden-state reads.
source_policy.indistinguishability: Assert exact full trajectory byte equality of mode0 and mode1, including observation and reward, across all 16 source episodes per fixture. Additionally test 32 extra reset states outside source.
source_policy.active: Reserved next gate: at most 2 four-step episodes, 8 action steps total per context; source policy must use observed histories only. Do not implement active policy in this first gate.
source_policy.positive_causal_witness: For each context and every chosen validation start, reset both modes to same visible state, step trigger once and assert immediate observation/reward equal. Then step action0 once and assert at least one delayed visible channel differs. Only auditor-only helper may read trigger; learner cannot.
source_policy.negative_controls: No-trigger action0 episodes remain equal at every step; no-latch ablation eliminates paired divergence for all tested intervention action sequences; changing mode is not visible in immediate output.
source_policy.collision: Source SHA computed over public rows alone, no mode or context labels embedded in learner source data; context ID used only for choosing mode-paired world and deterministic resets.

qualifications.DEV_FIXTURE_VALID: All 8 pairs satisfy exact passive equivalence, delayed action witness, no-trigger control, no-latch ablation, deterministic replay, strict source budget, observer field isolation, original IDs disallowed, Linux and Windows fixture tests PASS.
qualifications.DEV_FIXTURE_NEGATIVE: Any pair not passive-equivalent or lacking delayed causal witness; stop, preserve negative, no post-result task-rule tuning.
qualifications.INVALID: Mode/trigger hidden parameter leaks to source learner, original first-use, inconsistent budgets, SHA/source drift or manipulated evaluation target.
qualifications.engineering: After fixture tests pass, pin source G29 and run full inherited regression cross-OS on exact candidate SHA. No scientific performance claim under this gate.
qualifications.scientific: NOT TESTABLE: requires independent strong symbolic and fully-trained conventional controls and paired unfamiliar-world transfer/retention under a frozen blind evaluator.
